checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Water bottle main subject, fully visible
must.why: Centered bottle, entire body and cap in frame.
Body is matte black with soft sheen; only the cap is steel.
White marble with grey veins at the bottom; the surface band is fairly narrow.
Diffused light, soft faint shadow, no harsh glare.

faults.what: Marble occupies only a thin strip at the bottom, so the surface is less prominent than it could be
Bottle base looks slightly flat and lightly grounded, with a faint reflection

summary: A clean, centered matte black bottle stands on veined white marble in soft light. The marble is only a narrow strip and the image is small.
